items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: Joe and I were pretty good buddies. We were friends.

ctx.x: Did Boe have last decision on what tunes were recorded?

No. No. Joe had, yeah. Joe had. But how it was, we recorded the tunes that we thought were good. We did more. We did more like that. She just liked it because a girl from Cucamonga. That was a take off on Oop Oop Adu. Yeah. And Oop Oop Adu was a big tune and so I don't know, I just wrote the girl from Cucamonga. And that was in Cucamonga, California, that was a pretty big record. And it was even, it was even a theme song on a radio station in Cucamonga, California.
